title: Design System: AgentDa — The Route Card

display.purpose: The printed objective headline. Condensed, balanced, 1.5rem to 1.875rem.

headline.purpose: The objective while it is being typed, as an auto-growing ruled line.

title.purpose: A camp's own editable name in the day list.

body.purpose: Panel prose and the finish line; measure capped at 54-68ch.

caption.purpose: Hints, counts and metadata, in tabular figures.

label.purpose: Printed field and band labels, stamps, and D<n> camp markers. Condensed, uppercase.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The route card and the sign-in sheet — the only shadow in the system, so the sheet reads as resting on a table.

shadows.name: punch-inset
shadows.purpose: A camp's punched hole, so the recess reads as removed material.

shadows.name: focus-rule
shadows.purpose: A ruled input on focus doubles its underline in Hi-Vis Deep instead of glowing.

motion.name: sheet-fill
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: the sheet filling itself in when the phase changes. Opacity only, short and settled well before any capture.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition timing for state changes.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Default transition duration, e.g. a camp row's selection tint.

components.name: Punched Tab (primary action)
components.description: The single primary action: ink on hi-vis orange with punched sheet-coloured end-holes. Used once per card ('Draft the route', 'Approve and schedule', 'Open my card').

components.name: Edge Tab (secondary action)
components.description: A quieter control: ink outline on the sheet with small ringed circular ends. The quiet modifier drops the rings for repeated row actions so the device does not dilute down a list.

components.name: Ruled Line Input
components.description: A ruled line you type onto: no box, just the print's rule. Focus doubles the underline in hi-vis. This is the only text-field treatment in the system.

components.name: Route Card
components.description: The one sheet: waxed stock capped at 760px with a full-bleed steel header band, the objective, and a ruled footer. The only lifted object on the slate ground.

components.name: Printed Label
components.description: The system's labeling voice: condensed, uppercase, 11px with wide tracking. Used for band labels, field labels, camp markers, and stamps.

components.name: Folded Tag Stamp
components.description: A printed tag whose top-right corner is cut back like a card in a file, with a shaded fold flap. Rotated slightly and tinted by the ink / hivis / fault tones.

components.name: Punch
components.description: The hole a camp is marked through, with a shallow inset so it reads as removed material. Marked punches fill hi-vis for a selection or a chosen channel.

components.name: Date Strip
components.description: The deadline arithmetic stated flatly: Day 1 to Day N in tabular figures, bounded by soft rules, with the end date in Hi-Vis Deep and a camp count at the right.

components.name: Notice
components.description: A bordered recess block for warnings and flags: Steel by default, Rust for a fault, Hi-Vis Deep for a limit. Carries an uppercase label over soft prose.

components.name: Field Row
components.description: A printed key/value line, the way a form states a fact: uppercase Ink Faint label left, semibold tabular value right, separated by a soft rule.

narrative.overview:
A lit waxed route card lying on a deep slate table. The whole surface is one printed sheet that grows through five states — capture, planning, clarify, review, approved — rather than five screens or a progress-dot stepper. The card is the interface: its steel header band states what the sheet is and where it stands, its objective is a large inked line, its deadline is a dashed hi-vis turn-around rule at the profile's summit, and its single primary action is a punched tab at the foot.

The character is industrial signage and outfitter's paperwork: printed rules, punched camps, folded tags, tabular figures. Color is two materials and one signal — a dark slate ground, a waxed sheet, and a rationed hi-vis orange that belongs only to the turn-around rule and the one action, because its rarity is what carries the deadline. Type is a single grotesque on a width axis; the condensed cut reads as stencilled camp markers and printed labels, never as a second voice.

Depth is material, not decorative. The sheet is the only lifted object; the ground is flat. Confirmed visual rejections: no points or streaks drawn as ornaments, no progress dots, no confetti, no "you've got this" gradients or glass, and nothing of the cream-and-serif calming-coach aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: One printed sheet, ~760px, centred on a deep slate ground.
Two materials (slate ground / waxed sheet) plus one rationed hi-vis signal.
A single family, Archivo, used on a `wdth` axis; condensed for labels and camp markers.
Depth from one deep sheet shadow and tonal layering, plus a punched-hole inset.
Controls are ruled card fields and punched tabs; never pills, boxes, or switches.
Tabular figures everywhere a date, time, or count appears.

rules.name: The Rationed Hi-Vis Rule
rules.body: Hi-vis orange (#ff5a1f) appears only on the turn-around rule and the single primary action. When orange must be read as type on the sheet, use Hi-Vis Deep (#c63c08). The orange is never a second accent, chrome, or decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Material Rule
rules.body: Every surface is either the slate ground or the waxed sheet. There is no third surface tone; recess and rule tints of the sheet carry every subordinate zone.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo is the only family. Emphasis comes from weight and the width axis, never from a second face or a display replacement.

rules.name: The Condensed Print Rule
rules.body: Anything printed as a label, stamp, or camp marker is set in the condensed cut (font-stretch: 88%) at 11px with wide tracking. The label voice is never rendered in the normal width.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The sheet casts one deep shadow; nothing else in the flow casts one. Depth on the ground is achieved by tonal separation, not by adding shadows to more elements.

rules.name: The Square-Or-Tab Rule
rules.body: Every control corner is square or a 2px tab. Pills and rounded buttons do not exist in this world; the only round geometry is a punched hole.

rules.name: The Cut-Corner Rule
rules.body: Tags and stamps are distinguished by a cut top-right corner with a shaded flap, not by radius or color fill.

dos: Do keep hi-vis orange (#ff5a1f) to the turn-around rule and the one primary action, and use Hi-Vis Deep (#c63c08) when orange must be type on the sheet.
Do render every input as a ruled line on the sheet; no boxed fields.
Do hold the card at 760px centred, and the sign-in sheet at 440px.
Do set labels, stamps, camp markers, and the objective in the condensed cut (font-stretch: 88%).
Do use tabular figures for every date, time, and count.
Do keep the sheet's single deep shadow, and express everything else through tonal recess and hairline rules.
Do make destructive actions arm before they fire, with the label stating the consequence.
donts: Don't introduce pills, switches, or rounded buttons; corners are square or a 2px tab.
Don't add a second type family or substitute a system display face for Archivo.
Don't spend the orange anywhere else — no second accent, no orange chrome or decoration.
Don't add gradients, glass, confetti, or glow effects; depth is one shadow and flat tonal layering.
Don't gray secondary text on a colored surface; tint it from the palette (Ink Soft, Steel) instead.
Don't revive the cream-and-serif calming-coach aesthetic, or draw the flow's commitment as progress dots.
